name: min-entrada
description: Minimal NT8 round (user priority 2026-10-24): one market buy of 1 MNQ on Sim101 with an OCO stop 40 / target 80 ticks from the fill price, reports back, then flatten. Pauses for Enter before each command. NT8-compatible.

steps.text: Plugin conectado. Pressione Enter para enviar a ENTRADA: compra 1 MNQ 12-26 a mercado em Sim101, stop 40 ticks (10,00 pontos) e alvo 80 ticks (20,00 pontos) a partir do preço do fill. / Plugin connected. Press Enter to send the ENTRY: buy 1 MNQ 12-26 market on Sim101, stop 40 ticks (10.00 points), target 80 ticks (20.00 points) from the fill price.

Entrada executada e stop/alvo ativos. Confira a aba Orders do NT8 e pressione Enter para enviar o FLATTEN (zerar). / Entry filled, stop and target working. Check the NT8 Orders tab, then press Enter to send the FLATTEN.
